name: ae.brainy/brainy-48
summary: Brainy 的 MCP 条目列出了浏览自动化方案、申请评估和比较 AI 工具单席位成本的功能。发布方称其服务面向阿联酋和西班牙，不绑定特定模型。

Brainy’s MCP listing describes tools for browsing automation options, requesting an assessment, and comparing per-seat AI costs. The publisher describes its service as tailored to the UAE and Spain and independent of any one model.
